def-l160.label: IPL win rate defending 160–179, 2022–2026
def-l160.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
def-l160.query: SELECT CASE WHEN i1.runs < 160 THEN 'under 160' WHEN i1.runs < 180 THEN '160–179' WHEN i1.runs < 200 THEN '180–199' ELSE '200+' END band, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id = i1.batting_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won, SUM(CASE WHEN i1.batting_team_id IN (7,12) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tn, SUM(CASE WHEN i1.batting_team_id IN (7,12) AND m.winner_id = i1.batting_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tw FROM matches m JOIN innings i1 ON i1.match_id = m.match_id AND i1.innings_number = 1 WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022 GROUP BY band

defd-team-e1.label: PBKS death overs economy, 2008–2023
defd-team-e1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
defd-team-e1.query: SELECT SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (7,12)

defd-good-seasons.label: Seasons PBKS conceded less than the league in the death overs
defd-good-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
defd-good-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (7,12) THEN (d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (7,12) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) team, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (7,12) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year
